title: Number of Islands
hints: Each island is a connected component of land cells under 4-directional adjacency. How do you count connected components?
Scan the grid; every time you meet a land cell you have not visited, that is a new island. Flood-fill from it so the rest of that island is never counted again.
Flood fill with a queue or an explicit stack (recursion on a 300 x 300 all-land grid exceeds Python's stack). Overwriting visited '1' cells with '0' avoids a separate visited set.
